input: Join a local urban sketching group this month

gold.taskTitle: Join a local urban sketching group this month
gold.taskDescription: Find and become an active member of a local urban sketching group within the current month.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood are you based in?
questions.description: Understanding the user's location to find relevant local groups.

questions.title: Have you sketched before, or are you a beginner?
questions.description: Gauging the user's experience level to match them with an appropriate group.

questions.title: What does joining mean to you — attending one meetup or fully joining?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the goal is a single attendance or formal membership.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred day of the week to meet?
questions.description: Understanding scheduling constraints to filter suitable groups.

questions.title: Are you open to online or virtual sketching groups as well?
questions.description: Determining if the search should be limited to in-person groups only.

questions.title: Have you already found any groups you are considering?
questions.description: Checking if the user has done prior research to avoid duplicating effort.

questions.title: What is stopping you from joining a group right now?
questions.description: Identifying the main barrier — confidence, time, finding a group, cost, etc.
